reminders_one_source.name: reminders_one_source
reminders_one_source.value: ("reminders"."event_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("reminders"."task_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("reminders"."document_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

reminders_personal_user.name: reminders_personal_user
reminders_personal_user.value: ("reminders"."audience" = 'user' AND "reminders"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reminders"."audience" <> 'user' AND "reminders"."user_id" IS NULL)

task_occurrences_closure.name: task_occurrences_closure
task_occurrences_closure.value: ("task_occurrences"."state" = 'active' AND "task_occurrences"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "task_occurrences"."closed_by" IS NULL) OR ("task_occurrences"."state" IN ('done', 'skipped') AND "task_occurrences"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."closed_at" >= 0)
